text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh noooo! I wonder where I left them…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I made a lot of flyers for today's street performance!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You don't think someone took all of them, do you?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: No! One flyer per person! I am everyone's Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon exhausts herself running around looking for the paper bags full of her flyers.
